states.caption: Move 22 (Nigel to play, up 379-326). Rack AEELLNT, 7 tiles in the bag, 14 unseen. Nigel exchanged EELLT, keeping AN.

Why not ALLEE: after ALLEE (Nigel 395) and Mike's reply RULIEST (396), Nigel holds CEINNTT with only A,D unseen -- and cannot reach a triple with a CLOSE hook (his best is ENCLOSE for ~12). Mike's leftover A,D win.
What happened: Nigel drew the C and played CLAN (making CLOSE across row 12), leaving one tile in the bag.
Mike bingos RELISTEN; Nigel answers with his own out-bingo ENTAILER (hooking the R) to win 495-412.
